bibl.title: The utility ware assemblage from the hermitage in tomb MMA 1152 in West Thebes. Selected issues, provisional characteristics, research methodology.
bibl.seg: Tomasz Górecki, The utility ware assemblage from the hermitage in tomb MMA 1152 in West Thebes. Selected issues, provisional characteristics, research methodology.
Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/1. Research (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 749-772, figg.
bibl.note: Presents a pottery assemblage from a hermitage installed inside a Pharaonic tomb (MMA [TT] 1152) in Sheikh Abd el-Gurna, inhabited by monks from the end of the 5th to the beginning of the 8th century. Particular attention was paid to observations regarding the function and importance of vessels in the everyday life of the monks living in the hermitage, a reconstruction of their dietary habits and the nature of the work that they did.
